articles.summary: Achieves Top 10 Ranking Among Healthcare Suppliers from Modern Healthcare Medical Properties Trust, Inc. (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today announced that, for the sixth consecutive year, it was named one of Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in healthcare and, for the second time, one of America’s Greenest Companies by Newsweek and Plant-A Insights Group. “Continuing to be recognized by Modern Healthcare and Newsweek is a tremendous honor,” said Edward K. Aldag, Jr., MPT’s Chairman, President, and CEO. “While these recognitions highlight different areas of our business, both reflect our commitment to being a responsible company, whether through the workplace we create for our employees or the environmental practices we advance across our footprint. articles.summary: MPT (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today announced it will host a conference call and webcast on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results. A press release with the third quarter 2026 financial results will be issued before the market opens on October 29, 2026. The dial-in numbers for the conference call are 833-461-5787 (Toll-Free) and 585-542-9983, and the Meeting ID is 336661409 to join the conference. Call participants are encouraged to dial in 10-15 minutes early to ensure registration is completed prior to the start of the conference. The conference call will also be webcast live on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website, www.mpt.com . A webcast replay of the call will be available shortly after the call’s completion. The webcast replay will be available for one year on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website.
